info.name: SedBank API
info.description:
Full API coverage for the SedBank digital lending platform, organised by module.

The collection is written as an ordered regression run: it signs in as each role, walks one loan from application through disbursement, repayment and closure, exercises the admin masters, and asserts the role guards. Ids and tokens are passed between requests through collection variables, so it runs headlessly with Newman against local or deployed environments.

Run with:
  npm run test:api
  newman run qa/postman/SedBank.postman_collection.json -e qa/postman/SedBank.local.postman_environment.json

Requires ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS=true on the target API for the bureau `simulate` parameter and the loan back-dating hook.
